messages:
maria: quick thread — we updated the modal that appears when a user terminates a GPU instance. want a tiny copy + a11y pass before we ship. screenshot in thread (not pasted). anuj: thanks. current primary CTA is 'Terminate' which feels terse and ambiguous to non-eng teams. also worry users won't understand whether active sessions are ended. :thinking_face: choi: agree. short, explicit phrasing is better. but we should avoid super long CTA buttons. propose primary: 'Terminate instance' and add secondary help text under the modal explaining session behavior. jess: question — do we have telemetry on how often users expect sessions to persist vs be killed? might help choose wording. anuj: not much signal. ops tickets mention 'my job got killed unexpectedly' twice last quarter. leaning toward being explicit about ending sessions. maria: new copy mock: header: 'Terminate GPU instance' body: 'This will permanently stop the instance and end any active sessions. Any unsaved work on attached sessions cannot be recovered.' primary button: 'Terminate instance' secondary: 'Cancel' subtle inline link: 'Export logs before terminating' choi: that's good. can we make the destructive action more explicit in the button aria-label for screen readers? e.g., aria-label="Terminate GPU instance and end active sessions" so the button text stays short but screen readers get the full context. accessibility-bot: a11y note: yes — add an aria-describedby on the primary button pointing to the explanatory paragraph id so screen readers read context when focus lands. also ensure focus order: focus should land on 'Cancel' by default for destructive modals unless product decides otherwise. maria: hmm, default focus on Cancel could reduce accidental terminations, but product wants keyboard-first flows for power users. thoughts? jess: we can set initial focus to the modal container and rely on clearly labeled buttons. But leaning safer: default focus on Cancel; tab to primary. anuj: fine with Cancel default. adjust copy to make primary status visually prominent (red) but not auto-focused. choi: small copy nit: in body change 'This will permanently stop the instance and end any active sessions.' to 'Stopping this instance will end all active sessions and stop billing for compute. This action cannot be undone.' Adds billing clarity. maria: love that — concise and covers consequences. product-bot: checklist: [x] short CTA text [x] aria-label longer description [ ] confirm focus order set to Cancel [ ] color contrast check on red button [ ] caption for unsaved work guidance accessibility-bot: color contrast: ensure the red meets WCAG AA for button text on the background. also add keyboard shortcut hint? only if we keep it consistent with other destructive modals. jess: final proposed copy below (for devs to paste): ```
Terminate GPU instance

Stopping this instance will end all active sessions and stop compute billing. This action cannot be undone. Any unsaved work may be lost.

``` maria: perfect. small UX ask: add inline link 'How billing works' in the paragraph (opens docs) and a small 'Export sessions' action in the modal footer. choi: implementation note for devs: don't use autofocus on the primary, set initial focus to Cancel (or the close icon). include role="dialog" and aria-modal="true". anuj: adding a quick unit test to assert aria-describedby exists and focus default is Cancel. i'll add that to the PR. maria: thanks everyone! i'll update the Figma and drop assets into the PR. :thumbsup: product-bot: reminder: please include copy in i18n keys: modal.terminate.title, modal.terminate.body, modal.terminate.primary, modal.terminate.secondary accessibility-bot: follow-up: run the screen-reader check in staging once merged. jess: if no objections i'll mark this resolved by EOD and ship with the next patch release.
